what: A1 — THE ADDITIVE TELL IS DELETED, so the anchor spells the `×` sentence instead of the `+` one. This family splits by FOLD (D163) and "more" is the only word that does the splitting; without it the printed row stops reading AND the anchor claims a string the column prints ZERO times (§6 measures that). The most likely honest-looking edit at this line, and the one a `+`/`×` mix-up would produce.

replace: /^This attack does (\d+) damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent['’]s Pokémon\.$/;

what: B1 — `per >= 1` BECOMES `per >= 0`. The printed-zero guard every arm in both readers carries: a `0 more damage` sentence must stay on the LOUD ATTACK_EFFECT_SKIPPED path rather than deriving a bonus that adds nothing. Invisible on every printed row (the column prints 10) and visible only on §2's constructed zero.

B2 — THE ARM RETURNS THE SHIPPED `damageCountersOnOpponentActive` INSTEAD. The sentence still reads, `BUILT.attack` still steps, `resolvedByAnyReader` still answers true and the census is UNMOVED — the derived program is simply wrong about the scope, reading the Active alone where the card says the whole board. §2 sees the shape and §3's two half-boards see the number: the Bench-only board falls from 40 to 10 while the Active-only board is unchanged, which is exactly why those two boards are driven separately.
